claim_text: Regular physical activity is associated with lower resting heart rate.
evidence_text: In a cohort of 1,200 adults, participants reporting five or more exercise sessions per week had a mean resting heart rate 6 bpm lower than sedentary participants.

claim_text: Dietary fibre intake reduces gut transit time.
evidence_text: Across the trial arms, transit time did not differ significantly between the high-fibre and control groups (p = 0.62).

claim_text: Sleep duration influences next-day mood ratings.
evidence_text: The authors describe the study population and the recruitment window, and report the distribution of participant ages.

claim_text: Caffeine intake late in the day delays sleep onset.
evidence_text: Participants consuming caffeine after 16:00 recorded a mean sleep-onset latency 23 minutes longer than those who did not.

claim_text: Hydration status has no relationship with reported fatigue.
evidence_text: Lower hydration scores were accompanied by consistently higher fatigue ratings throughout the observation period.
